crossRefs.note: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself,” then he took off his sandal.

people.name: Boaz
people.line: Kinsman-redeemer who married Ruth, ancestor of David and Jesus

translations.web: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself,” then he took off his sandal.
translations.bsb: So the kinsman-redeemer removed his sandal and said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself.”
translations.kjv: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.
translations.asv: So the near kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thyself. And he drew off his shoe.
